articles.title: 19 Best Treatments for Dark Circles, According to Derms | NBC Select
articles.summary: Dermatologists share how to treat dark circles and under-eye puffiness. Browse the best eye creams, under-eye patches, sunscreens, silk pillowcases and more.
articles.body: A stressful lifestyle, busy schedule and lack of sleep are known to cause dark under-eye circles — but they aren’t the only possible reasons. Other factors such as genetics, dehydration and age, can also cause them to form, making them uniquely challenging to treat. “Dark circles result from under-eye puffiness, volume loss, hyperpigmentation and visibility of the blood vessels in the under-eye area,” says Dr. Marisa Garshick, a board-certified dermatologist at MDCS Dermatology in New York City. Though cosmetic procedures like injectable fillers can offer a more effective long-term treatment, plenty of over-the-counter skin care products can help remedy discoloration over time. To help you determine the best way to treat your dark under-eye circles, I spoke to dermatologists about common causes, effective ingredients and cosmetic treatments worth investing in. I also compiled editor- and expert-recommended products that can help reduce the appearance of under-eye circles. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. Best products for treating dark under-eye circles Everything on the list below has been recommended by dermatologists, are an NBC Selected editor favorite or have ingredients that align with the advice and guidance of our experts. Best eye creams for dark circles One of our favorite eye creams, this RoC option has retinol to help stimulate collagen production (which experts say keeps the structure of your skin firm and provides underlying support), but is also gentle enough that it doesn’t irritate the delicate under-eye skin, says Dr. Nkem Ugonabo, a board-certified dermatologist at Union Derm. It also has glycerin, which pulls moisture into the skin, says Dr. Heidi Waldorf, a board-certified dermatologist and owner of Waldorf Dermatology Aesthetics. L’Oreal’s Revitalift eye cream includes a combination of retinol, vitamin C and hyaluronic acid to reduce puffiness and brighten the skin under the eyes. It also gets top marks from Waldorf for having skin-plumping glycerin and dimethicone, as well as caffeine forreducing redness and discoloration. Neutrogena’s retinol eye cream is also made with hyaluronic acid and dimethicone, and is a great drugstore option, according to Waldorf. It not only works to decrease the appearance of fine lines and dark circles, but also keeps the delicate skin under your eyes hydrated, she says. I love using Isdin’s K-Ox eye cream daily to combat my dark circles. It brightens my under eyes, leaves the area feeling hydrated and the ceramic applicator is cooling on my skin. The eye cream also has haloxyl, an ingredient that helps even out skin tone and keeps the under eyes firm, according to the brand. This eye cream has a lightweight, whipped texture and is a favorite of NBC Selected reporter Zoe Malin. Like others on our list, this eye cream has vitamin C and caffeine to help brighten, depuff and support the production of collagen, according to the brand. Malin, who dabs less than ¼ of a teaspoon onto the skin, stores the cream in her fridge to provide an instant cooling effect. This eye cream has vitamin C, which helps brighten the under-eye area, experts say. It also has jojoba seed oil, shea butter and beeswax, which are all gentle for the eye area and hydrate the skin, according to the brand. However, although the cream is fragrance-free, it still may irritate more sensitive eyes. This Garnier eye roller can serve as a quick fix for under-eye puffiness and dark circles because it has caffeine, vitamin C and mint to help reduce the appearance of the under-eye bags, says Garshick. Its convenient roll-on applicator has a cooling effect that can help you easily apply the gel cream to the under-eye area, according to the brand. This Alastin eye treatment has brightening and hydrating ingredients like niacinamide and green tea, says Ugonabo. It also has a blend of active peptides that helps firm up the skin and even out skin tone under the eyes, according to the brand. It’s noncomedogenic and hypoallergenic, which also makes it a good option for those with sensitive skin. Waldorf recommends Supergoop’s mineral eye cream because it has zinc oxide, which is great for sensitive skin, and SPF 40 to protect the skin from harmful UV rays (you should look for a sunscreen with a minimum SPF 30 to provide an adequate amount of protection, experts say in our guide to face sunscreens.) This SPF eye cream also has a blend of probiotics and caffeine to brighten the skin and alleviate any redness, according to the brand. Cooling products are helpful for reducing swelling and puffiness since the cold causes the blood vessels to constrict, says Garshick. “This is why I often recommend putting eye cream in the refrigerator to get the added cooling benefit or using eye creams that contain a cold metal applicator for the added de-puffing benefit,” she says. This Charlotte Tilbury eye serum comes with a metal applicator that has an instant cooling effect to de-puff the eyes, according to the brand. It also has a blend of caffeine and peptides, which our experts say can keep the under-eye area looking smoother, brighter and more refreshed. Packed with alpha hydroxy acids, hyaluronic acid and peptides, this eye cream has protective antioxidant benefits, says Waldorf. “Fruit stem extract contains antioxidants and other ingredients that may be protective to aging cells. It also has caffeine to reduce puffiness,” she says. This Neocutis eye cream targets dark circles with ingredients like vitamin C, caffeine and peptides. It also has growth hormones, which are proteins that help regulate good collagen processes (which restores the skin) and reduce bad collagen processes to avoid volume loss around the under-eye area, according to our experts. Suitable for all skin types, the brand recommends using this cream in the morning and evening. Best eye masks and patches for dark circles These Pacifica patches are packed with ingredients like hyaluronic acid and vitamin C to brighten and hydrate your under eyes. The patches are also infused with aloe to moisturize and soothe the delicate skin around the eyes, according to the brand. You can purchase these individually or purchase them in a pack of four. One of our favorite under-eye patches, this expert-recommended option has hyaluronic acid and caffeine to help improve the look of fine lines and under-eye hyperpigmentation, according to the brand. The patches are fragrance-free, and you can apply them both morning and night. “Puffiness can be reduced temporarily by using topicals with ingredients like green tea polyphenols and caffeine, which helps the fluid shift,” says Waldorf. She likes using these Skyn Iceland topical cooling pads before a special occasion, presentation or photo shoot to help de-puff and brighten up her under eyes. You can pop them into the fridge for a cooling effect that also helps reduce swelling and puffiness, says Waldorf. Free of parabens and silicones, these pads can help seal moisture and plump the skin in just 10 minutes, according to the brand. More treatments to help reduce dark circles “I often recommend patients apply a tiny amount of Aquaphor healing ointment under the eye at night to help seal in moisture,” says Ugonabo. Designed for dry, cracked skin, the Aquaphor Healing Ointment can go beyond under-eye care: You can use it as a lip moisturizer, facial moisturizer, hydrating mask and more, according to the brand. Sunscreen helps protect the skin from UV rays that cause sun damage, which can ultimately help diminish the appearance of dark circles in the process, says Dr. David Rayhan, a board-certified dermatologist at Rayhan Dermatology. This tinted sunscreen from EltaMD — which makes some of our favorite SPF lip balms and tinted moisturizers — comes recommended by Rayhan because “it contains zinc oxide and iron oxide, which help prevent damage from ultraviolet light,” he says. Silk sheets and pillowcases can help prevent tugging at the skin, which can ultimately reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, say experts in our guide to silk bedding. Though they’re not going to fully treat dark circles, chronic friction can cause pigment production: “If your pillowcase is irritating your eyelids, this could be contributing to the problem,” says Rayhan. Waldorf recommends investing in this Slip silk pillowcase because it’s machine-washable and designed to reduce friction on your face. The pillowcase is available in both Queen and King sizes and comes in multiple colorways, including pink, silver and pistachio. Some makeup-removing wipes, especially those that require rubbing the under-eye area, may cause redness and irritation and even worsen hyperpigmentation, according to our experts. Farmacy makes some of our favorite acne scar treatments and editor-favorite lip masks, and this balm from the brand is one I use daily to double cleanse. It has a smooth, silky consistency and melts easily into my skin, so I don’t have to rub my eyes with a coarse wipe to remove my eye makeup. It has sunflower and ginger root oils to remove eye makeup without stripping or drying out the skin, and it has papaya extract to gently exfoliate, according to the brand. What is the best way to get rid of dark circles? Being able to fully erase under-eye circles is rare. But even though some causes are tougher to treat than others, most of the time there are products that can provide some improvement, says Rayhan. Since there are many factors that cause dark circles, you usually need to treat them using a few different methods, he says. Cosmetic procedures are the most effective way to treat dark circles, according to our experts. If the discoloration is caused by volume loss creating shadows, injectable fillers (typically hyaluronic acid-based) or a lower eyelift (called lower blepharoplasty) are most effective, while laser skin resurfacing with a CO2 laser can help with thinning of the skin and blood pooling, says Rayhan. Chemical peels performed in-office by a dermatologist or skin care professional can also help treat hyperpigmentation or discoloration, says Garshick. If cosmetic procedures aren’t for you, some over-the-counter eye creams and skin care products can still help reduce the appearance of dark circles. (Keep in mind that you won’t get the same results as you would get from in-house cosmetic procedures.) One of the best ways to do this is by hydrating and moisturizing the area using eye creams with ingredients that induce collagen, like retinol and vitamin C. You should always wear sunscreen during the day — even around the eyelids — to protect the skin, especially since hyperpigmentation from sun damage can worsen dark circles over time, according to Rayhan. While some factors may be out of your control, “using sunscreen helps prevent UV damage that can contribute to volume loss and hyperpigmentation which can otherwise lead to dark circles,” says Garshick. How I picked the best dark circles treatments When shopping for over-the-counter treatments for dark under-eye circles, the dermatologists I spoke to recommend considering the following factors: Ingredients: Consider skin care products that have key ingredients like hyaluronic acid (to hydrate), retinol (to reduce fine lines), caffeine and vitamin C (to brighten). All these ingredients help treat and reduce the appearance of dark under-eye circles. (I go more in-depth about these ingredients below.) Type of product: In addition to eye creams, silk pillowcases and cooling under-eye patches can also help reduce the appearance of dark circles over time. Applying sunscreen around the eyes and eyelids can also protect the skin from sun damage that may worsen the appearance of dark circles, experts say. Meet our dermatology experts At NBC Selected, we work with experts who have specialized knowledge and authority based on relevant training and/or experience. We also take steps to ensure that all expert advice and recommendations are made independently and with no undisclosed financial conflicts of interest. Dr. Marisa Garshick is a board-certified dermatologist at MDCS Dermatology in New York City and an assistant clinical professor of dermatology at NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center.Dr. Nkem Ugonabo is a board-certified dermatologist with advanced fellowship training in cosmetic dermatology and lasers at Union Derm in New York City.Dr. Heidi Waldorf is a board-certified dermatologist and owner of Waldorf Dermatology AestheticsDr. David Rayhan is a board-certified dermatologist at Rayhan Dermatology in Huntington Beach, California. Why trust NBC Select? I’m an updates editor at NBC Selected and I’ve covered skin care since 2021. For this article, I spoke to four dermatologists to narrow down the best treatments for dark under-eye circles, and highlighted their recommendations for the best products to consider. articles.title: A couple was browsing a random yard sale. Then the wife found a 19-year-old photo of her husband.
articles.summary: While browsing a yard sale, a man and his wife stumbled upon a plastic tote filled with his late mother's lost belongings and 20-year-old family photos.
articles.body:
Shawn, a YouTuber known as The Long Way Show, discovered a 19-year-old photograph of himself and his family at a yard sale, sparking memories of his childhood and deceased mother.

The photograph was found in a plastic tote at the yard sale, along with other items belonging to Shawn's late mother, including Corelle dishes, a bee figurine, and vintage Red Rose tea cards.

Shawn decided to only purchase the photographs, bee figurine, and tea cards, reflecting on his tendency to hoard items left behind by deceased relatives and realizing that preserving memories does not require keeping every object.

A man named Shawn ( @TheLongWayShow ), who runs the YouTube channel The Long Way Around , has always been his family's self-appointed " historian ." He holds onto all the heirlooms, photographs, and antiques. Recently, he was wondering what happened to some of his childhood keepsakes after his mother died in 2014. His stepfather then lost their home, and most of the possessions inside disappeared along with it.

One August weekend in 2026, Shawn and his wife hit a string of yard sales with nothing to show for it. Then they stopped at one more driveway.

While Shawn was combing through piles of old stuff, his wife yelled out from across the yard.

She'd opened a plastic tote and asked why there was a picture of her husband inside it.

Shawn walked over to find that there was indeed a photograph of himself, his two brothers, their children, and his brother's dog taken 19 years earlier, inside. As they dug deeper, they found a collection of his mom's photographs, including pictures from her trip to Toronto.

When the couple asked the seller where the totes came from, he guessed from a storage locker clean-out.

Shawn found his mom's Corelle dishes, cups, mugs, and a tiny bee figurine she used to keep on a shelf. He also found toolboxes filled with his stepfather's old tools, Coca-Cola collectibles, and hundreds of vintage Red Rose tea cards he remembered playing with as a child.

But Shawn didn't buy everything . He purchased the photographs, the bee figurine, and the Red Rose cards. He left the mugs, dishes, tools, and collectibles behind.

Shawn explained in his video that he's been trying to stop keeping everything his dead relatives left behind as he's realized hoarding every object isn't necessary to preserve the memories attached to it.

"I found my family at a yard sale today, unexpectedly, a dozen years after Mom had passed," Shawn said.

articles.title: Acidente na Raposo Tavares em Itapetininga deixa dois em estado grave | G1
articles.standfirst: Um passageiro também foi socorrido em estado grave, enquanto outro teve apenas ferimentos leves. Segundo a Artesp, todas as faixas e o acostamento precisaram ser interditados.
articles.summary: Um motorista foi socorrido em estado grave após bater o carro contra uma defensa metálica na Rodovia Raposo Tavares, em Itapetininga, na madrugada de sábado (5).
articles.body:
Duas pessoas foram socorridas em estado grave — Foto: Divulgação/Artesp

Um motorista foi socorrido em estado grave após perder o controle da direção e bater contra uma defensa metálica na Rodovia Raposo Tavares (SP-270), em Itapetininga (SP), na madrugada de sábado (5).

Segundo informações da Agência de Transportes do Estado de São Paulo (Artesp), o acidente ocorreu no quilômetro 187, da pista sentido interior. Um segundo passageiro também teve ferimentos graves, enquanto a terceira vítima sofreu apenas ferimentos leves.

Devido ao acidente, todas as faixas e o acostamento precisaram ser interditados, mas foram liberados por volta de 1h15. O veículo ficou completamente destruído (veja na imagem acima) .

Ainda conforme a Artesp, não houve registro de congestionamento. A unidade hospitalar onde as vítimas foram encaminhadas era desconhecida até a publicação desta reportagem.

articles.title: Mega-Sena: Apostas de Goiás ganham R$ 120 mil; prêmio vai a R$ 70 mi | G1
articles.standfirst: Jogos premiados foram feitos em Goiânia e Aparecida de Goiânia. Ninguém acertou as seis dezenas e prêmio acumulou em R$ 70 milhões.
articles.summary: A Mega-Sena premiou jogadores de Goiânia e Aparecida de Goiânia, enquanto o prêmio principal acumulou em R$ 70 milhões para o próximo sorteio de terça-feira.
articles.body:
Três apostas feita em Goiás acertaram cinco números da Mega-Sena e faturaram, juntas, R$ 120.581,40. Segundo a Caixa Econômica Federal, dois jogos premiados foram registrados em Goiânia e o terceiro em Aparecida de Goiânia , na Região Metropolitana da capital.

O sorteio foi realizado neste domingo (6), no Espaço da Sorte, em São Paulo. As dezenas sorteadas foram: 08 - 17 - 24 - 43 - 47 - 58.

Entre os ganhadores goianos, o maior prêmio ficou com um bolão de Goiânia, dividido em 18 cotas, que faturou R$ 60.290,64. As outras duas apostas eram simples e receberam R$ 30.145,38 cada.

Nenhuma aposta no país acertou as seis dezenas. Ao todo, 78 jogos fizeram a quina e 5.268 acertaram quatro números. Com isso, o prêmio principal acumulou e está estimado em R$ 70 milhões para o próximo sorteio, que será realizado na terça-feira (8).

Em Goiás, também houve apostas que acertaram a quadra e receberam prêmios na faixa de R$ 700. Entre as cidades com jogos premiados estão Anápolis , Buriti Alegre , Campinorte , Formosa , Hidrolândia , Ipameri , Jaraguá , Mairipotaba , Niquelândia , Paraúna , Quirinópolis , Rio Verde , Silvânia e Trindade .

Bilhetes da Mega-Sena, em imagem de arquivo — Foto: Marcelo Brandt/G1

Para participar da Mega-Sena, o apostador deve escolher de seis a 20 números entre as 60 dezenas disponíveis. Também é possível optar pela Surpresinha, em que o sistema escolhe os números, ou pela Teimosinha, que permite concorrer com a mesma combinação em concursos consecutivos.

As apostas podem ser feitas nas casas lotéricas credenciadas ou pela internet. A Mega-Sena premia quem acerta quatro, cinco ou seis números.

Os prêmios podem ser retirados em lotéricas credenciadas ou em agências da Caixa, conforme o valor. O ganhador tem até 90 dias após a data do sorteio para resgatar o dinheiro.

articles.title: Relembre os passos da chegada do Maroon 5 a Rio Preto | G1
articles.standfirst: Banda norte-americana faz neste domingo (6) seu primeiro show na cidade e abre a turnê 'Love Is Like' no Brasil. Relembre a venda de ingressos, os bastidores, a estrutura do palco e as regras de acesso.
articles.summary: Banda norte-americana faz neste domingo (6) seu primeiro show na cidade e abre a turnê 'Love Is Like' no Brasil. Relembre a venda de ingressos, bastidores e estrutura do palco.
articles.body:
A espera está prestes a terminar. Neste domingo (6), São José do Rio Preto (SP) se transforma na capital da música pop rock no Brasil ao receber a estreia da turnê nacional "Love Is Like", da banda norte-americana Maroon 5 . Pela primeira vez no interior paulista, o grupo liderado por Adam Levine deve reunir cerca de 25 mil pessoas no Recinto de Exposições Alberto Bertelli Lucatto e movimentar em torno de R$ 20 milhões na economia local.

Abaixo, o g1 relembra os principais marcos dessa trajetória, desde a confirmação histórica da data até os detalhes finais da véspera do espetáculo:

O anúncio surpresa e a corrida pelos ingressos

Zé Neto e Cristiano falam sobre vinda do Maroon 5 a Rio Preto após show em Votorantim (SP) — Foto: Danilo Guimarães/Divulgação

A mobilização começou no dia 28 de maio, quando o anúncio oficial confirmou Rio Preto como a única cidade do interior do país a integrar a rota da turnê. A notícia provocou correria imediata nas bilheterias virtuais e físicas: os ingressos foram disponibilizados com valores entre R$ 300 e R$ 1.500, distribuídos nos setores Pista, Pista Premium e Camarote Open, além da modalidade de ingresso solidário com doação de alimentos.

Atração nacional, exigências de camarim e contagem regressiva

Banda Lagum abre show do Maroon 5 no Brasil em São José do Rio Preto (SP) — Foto: Divulgação

Em 26 de agosto, a produção confirmou a banda mineira Lagum como o show de abertura oficial. O grupo de Belo Horizonte, referência da Geração Z e fã declarada do Maroon 5, preparou um repertório especial para esquentar a arena antes da atração principal.

Na mesma semana, o g1 revelou com exclusividade a lista de exigências do camarim dos artistas internacionais. Apesar do estrelato mundial, a banda fez solicitações consideradas modestas, mesclando produtos de luxo com um toque de valorização da produção local:

Maroon 5 se apresenta em São José do Rio Preto (SP) — Foto: Divulgação

Pó de café regional: Pedido especial de pó de café de marcas produzidas no interior paulista.

Águas especiais: No camarim principal, foram solicitadas 48 garrafas de água mineral comum e seis garrafas grandes de vidro das marcas importadas Voss e Acqua Panna.

Toalhas pretas: 24 toalhas de mão estritamente pretas para o palco e seis toalhas de banho grandes nos bastidores.

Palco gigante pronto e regras de segurança na véspera

Palco do primeiro show do Maroon 5 no Brasil é montado em São José do Rio Preto (SP) — Foto: Clara Sganzerla/g1

Na reta final de preparação, o Recinto de Exposições recebeu a montagem de uma estrutura monumental de 50 metros de largura, 18 metros de altura e 20 metros de profundidade. A cenografia conta com um painel de iluminação de LED de 28x12 metros, mais de 600 refletores de ponta e uma passarela de 27 metros de comprimento para aproximar o vocalista Adam Levine do público.

Neste sábado (5), véspera da apresentação, a organização divulgou o guia de acesso e as normas de segurança do evento.

Álbum 'Love Is Like', de Maroon 5 — Foto: Divulgação

Local: Recinto de Exposições Alberto Bertelli Lucatto (Rua Daniel Antônio de Freitas, 115, Distrito Industrial)

Transporte público: A linha 209 – Distrito Industrial opera com frota reforçada saindo da plataforma 09 do Terminal Urbano Central a partir das 16h, com ônibus extras disponibilizados na ida e no retorno ao término do show.

articles.title: Resgate de cão em Petrópolis: bombeiros retiram animal de bueiro | G1
articles.standfirst: Animal foi retirado em segurança por militares do 15º GBM durante atendimento realizado na madrugada deste sábado (5)
articles.summary: O resgate de cão em Petrópolis mobilizou o 15º GBM após o animal cair em um bueiro de cinco metros de profundidade na madrugada deste sábado no bairro de Corrêas.
articles.body:
Por causa do espaço reduzido, os militares utilizaram técnicas de salvamento em ambiente confinado para acessar o local e retirar o cão. — Foto: CBMERJ

Um cão foi resgatado por bombeiros após cair em um bueiro estreito, com cerca de cinco metros de profundidade, na Rua Carvalho Junior, em Corrêas, Petrópolis , na Região Serrana do Rio. O resgate aconteceu na madrugada deste sábado (5).

O Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (CBMERJ) foi acionado às 0h08. A equipe do 15º Grupamento de Petrópolis encontrou o animal preso no fundo da estrutura de concreto, sem conseguir voltar à superfície.

Por causa do espaço reduzido, os militares utilizaram técnicas de salvamento em ambiente confinado para acessar o local e retirar o cão.

articles.title: Afogamento em Santa Luzia d'Oeste: adolescente morre em balneário | G1
articles.standfirst: Armando Gabriel Marcelino Aires desapareceu na água no início da tarde de sábado (5). Corpo foi resgatado pelos bombeiros e escola publicou nota de pesar.
articles.summary: O estudante Armando Gabriel Marcelino Aires morreu no Balneário Municipal de Santa Luzia d'Oeste; Bombeiros resgataram o corpo e a escola do jovem publicou nota de pesar.
articles.body:
Armando Gabriel Marcelino Aires, de 16 anos — Foto: Reprodução/Redes sociais

O estudante Armando Gabriel Marcelino Aires, de 16 anos, morreu afogado no último sábado (5), no Balneário Municipal de Santa Luzia d'Oeste (RO). O corpo do jovem foi resgatado pelo Corpo de Bombeiros.

De acordo com o Corpo de Bombeiros de Rolim de Moura (RO), o afogamento aconteceu no início da tarde. A equipe foi acionada e, no local, testemunhas relataram que o jovem havia desaparecido na água havia cerca de uma hora.

Após buscas realizadas por meio de mergulho, o corpo foi localizado, mas o adolescente já estava sem vida. A vítima foi retirada da água e levada até uma viatura municipal, onde a equipe médica confirmou o óbito. A causa do afogamento não foi informada.

Armando era morador de Santa Luzia d'Oeste (RO) e cursava o ensino médio na Escola Estadual Juscelino Kubitschek.

O Grêmio Estudantil da escola publicou nas redes sociais uma nota de pesar lamentando a morte do estudante e se solidarizando com familiares, amigos, professores e toda a comunidade escolar, que está de luto.

“Neste momento de profunda tristeza, nos solidarizamos com seus familiares, amigos, professores e todos que tiveram a oportunidade de compartilhar momentos e histórias ao seu lado”, diz a nota.

articles.title: Samba campeão da Mangueira evoca Oyá em canto de liberdade e fé  | G1
articles.standfirst: Composição de Lequinho, Júnior Fionda, Gabriel Machado, Guilherme Sá, Rodrigo Bandolim e Orlando Ambrósio foi escolhida como hino oficial da escola para o Carnaval 2027.
articles.summary: Composição de Lequinho, Júnior Fionda, Gabriel Machado, Guilherme Sá, Rodrigo Bandolim e Orlando Ambrósio foi escolhida como hino oficial da escola para o Carnaval 2027.
articles.body:
Mangueira escolhe o samba enredo de 2027 — Foto: Thaís Brum/Divulgação

Já era manhã de domingo (6) quando a Estação Primeira de Mangueira escolheu o samba-enredo que será o hino oficial da escola no Carnaval 2027. A parceria formada por Lequinho, Júnior Fionda, Gabriel Machado, Guilherme Sá, Rodrigo Bandolim e Orlando Ambrósio venceu a disputa e foi consagrada pela comunidade, pelos segmentos e pela diretoria da verde e rosa.

Defendido pelos intérpretes Tinga, Grazzi Brasil e Daniela Mercury, o samba tem como um dos principais eixos a força de Oyá e a identidade da mulher negra.

A composição aborda temas como ancestralidade, religiosidade de matriz africana, intolerância religiosa e resistência feminina.

A escolha aconteceu depois de uma grande festa na quadra da Mangueira, que recebeu a comunidade e as torcidas das parcerias finalistas.

A programação começou com uma apresentação concebida e dirigida artisticamente por Fábio Batista, especialista em dança das religiões de matriz africana. A performance reuniu o time de show da Mangueira e bailarinos selecionados durante um workshop de dança afro, em uma apresentação que combinou dança, ancestralidade e a força dos orixás.

Em seguida, a bateria assumiu o protagonismo. Sob o comando dos mestres Rodrigo Explosão e Taranta Neto, o ritmo acompanhou passistas, baianas, casais de mestre-sala e porta-bandeira e outros segmentos da escola.

A bateria também revisitou sambas marcantes da história da Mangueira, transformando a quadra em uma celebração da memória e da tradição da escola.

Na sequência, as parcerias finalistas defenderam suas obras. As torcidas cantaram, levaram bandeiras e fizeram da quadra uma arena de samba, aumentando a expectativa pelo resultado.

Mangueira no Desfile das Campeãs de 2026 — Foto: Rafael Nascimento/g1

Antes do anúncio, os integrantes do carro de som da escola mantiveram o público cantando e sambando. Quando o resultado foi divulgado, a presidenta Guanayra Firmino agradeceu aos mangueirenses e encerrou o discurso dizendo: "É que eu sou preta, macumbeira e de Oyá".

Na sequência, o intérprete Dowglas Diniz entoou o samba campeão, e a quadra foi tomada pela comemoração.

Compositores: Lequinho, Júnior Fionda, Gabriel Machado, Guilherme Sá, Rodrigo Bandolim e Orlando Ambrósio.

"Quando toca o adaró Somos tantas numa só, a nação evoca minha mãe Iansã! Vira tempo, tempestade Pra varrer toda maldade, sob os raios da manhã.

Ah! Eparrey Meu povo é trovoada, O tambor do recomeço, Quando vira a encruzilhada... Sou rebeldia de Oluafefé, Pele de búfalo no corpo de mulher!

Afulelé adê ô, deixa incorporar Olonifé de Ogum, forja pra lutar Paixão que atiça, fogo de Akará! No coração de Xangô deixa ela girar!

Iyá mesan orun... Treme-terra... Desce o morro, sobe o rum… é guerra! Bate o oguê, que o sangue tem dendê, Tá pra nascer quem manda nela!

Ela dança no ilê axé, Dá caminho no axexê, Faz do seu furacão, balé, Dona do ajerê Meu ori, tua coragem, liberdade obirín Porque não existe macho que levante a mão pra mim!

É que eu sou preta, macumbeira e de Oyá Sou ventania que ninguém pode afrontar Colo de Ketu, solo do gueto, força de Orixá. Quem tem fé na quarta-feira sabe que eu não ando só.

O Brasil da intolerância eu despacho no ebó Nada fica no caminho, a rainha vai passar, Segura que o xirê vai começar!

Oyá Tetê Oyá Tetê Oyá Oyá Tetê Oyá Mangueira Yabá! Ê mamãe, traz de novo teu axé... Relampejou pra vitória.. Motumba Lè!"

O carnavalesco Sidnei França comemorou a escolha e afirmou que a parceria vencedora conseguiu traduzir a proposta do enredo para uma linguagem musical próxima da comunidade.

Segundo ele, o concurso mostrou a força de Oyá para um pensamento negro e suburbano e reforçou características que, na avaliação dele, estão no centro da identidade da Mangueira: negritude, pertencimento e representação do povo do morro.

"É muito bonito ver toda a comunidade cantando 'É que eu sou preta, macumbeira e de Oyá'. Isso é muito forte. Tenho muito orgulho de fazer parte da Mangueira", afirmou.

O enredo "Oyá por nós!" será desenvolvido por Sidnei França, que assina o carnaval da Mangueira pelo terceiro ano consecutivo.

A verde e rosa encerra a temporada de desfiles do Grupo Especial no dia 9 de fevereiro de 2027.

articles.title: Passageiro amarrado com fita em voo nos EUA é identificado | G1
articles.standfirst: Arthur Layne Lundeen, de 67 anos, foi preso após confusão em voo da American Airlines. Imobiliária encerrou vínculo profissional com ele após o episódio.
articles.summary: Arthur Layne Lundeen, de 67 anos, foi detido após o pouso e responde por agressão de segundo grau e “conduta desordeira”. FBI investiga o episódio.
articles.body:
Homem é amarrado a poltrona de avião após gritar e proferir xingamentos racistas e homofóbicos durante voo entre Dallas e Nova Jersey, nos EUA — Foto: Reprodção/Redes sociais

O passageiro que foi amarrado com fita adesiva a uma poltrona durante um voo da American Airlines, após uma confusão a bordo, foi identificado como Arthur Layne Lundeen , de 67 anos.

Ele foi preso depois que o avião pousou em Baltimore , no estado de Maryland , na costa leste dos Estados Unidos .

Lundeen responde a acusações de agressão de segundo grau e " conduta desordeira" , segundo a polícia responsável pela segurança dos transportes em Maryland e registros judiciais citados pela imprensa americana.

O caso ocorreu na quinta-feira (3), no voo 618, que seguia de Dallas, no Texas, para Newark, em Nova Jersey, na região de Nova York. A aeronave precisou mudar a rota e pousar em Baltimore por causa da ocorrência.

Segundo passageiros ouvidos pela ABC News, Lundeen começou a gritar, fazer comentários ofensivos contra funcionários da companhia e outros passageiros e usar xingamentos racistas e homofóbicos .

Em determinado momento, segundo testemunhas, ele também se envolveu em uma agressão física contra outro passageiro.

Juan Mejía, ex-agente de segurança que estava no voo, contou à emissora que decidiu intervir junto com outro passageiro. Lundeen foi então imobilizado na poltrona com fita adesiva e teve as mãos presas com braçadeiras plásticas.

“Não estávamos tentando machucá-lo. Estávamos tentando contê-lo e controlar a situação para que ela não piorasse”, disse Mejía à ABC News.

Uma passageira ouvida pela NBC News afirmou que Lundeen se debatia enquanto tripulantes e outros passageiros tentavam contê-lo. Ela também relatou que o homem dirigiu ofensas racistas a pessoas a bordo.

Depois do pouso em Baltimore, Lundeen foi retirado do avião e levado sob custódia. A aeronave seguiu posteriormente para Newark.

Arthur Layne Lundeen, de 67 anos, foi identificado como o passageiro detido após confusão em voo da American Airlines entre Dallas e Newark, nos EUA. — Foto: LinkedIn/Reprodução

O FBI, a polícia federal dos Estados Unidos , informou que está ouvindo testemunhas e reunindo informações sobre o que ocorreu durante o voo. O órgão disse que vai consultar a Procuradoria dos EUA em Maryland para decidir se haverá também acusações na esfera federal .

A Administração Federal de Aviação dos EUA (FAA), órgão responsável pela aviação civil no país, também investiga o episódio.

Segundo a Newsweek, Lundeen trabalhava no setor imobiliário em Tucson, cidade do estado do Arizona, no sudoeste dos EUA. A Long Realty , empresa à qual ele era ligado profissionalmente, informou à revista que encerrou o vínculo após tomar conhecimento do caso.

A empresa afirmou que a conduta descrita nas reportagens era incompatível com os padrões de profissionalismo e respeito esperados de seus profissionais.

De acordo com registros judiciais citados pela imprensa americana, Lundeen foi liberado após uma audiência inicial na sexta-feira (4) e deverá voltar ao tribunal em 19 de outubro.

A American Airlines afirmou que não tolera violência e que a segurança de passageiros e funcionários é sua prioridade.

Leia abaixo a nota da American Airlines:

"Em 3 de setembro, o voo 618 da American Airlines desviou sua rota para Baltimore devido a um passageiro que apresentava comportamento inadequado. Ao chegar, as autoridades policiais receberam a aeronave e auxiliaram no desembarque do passageiro antes que o voo seguisse para o seu destino. A segurança e o bem-estar de nossos clientes e membros da equipe são nossa prioridade máxima, e não toleramos violência. Agradecemos aos membros de nossa equipe pelo profissionalismo e aos nossos clientes pela compreensão."

Aviões da American Airlines no Aeroporto Internacional de Miami, nos Estados Unidos, em julho de 2015. — Foto: Alan Diaz/AP

articles.title: Incêndio em prédio deixa ao menos quatro pessoas mortas em Capanema | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo testemunhas, quatro pessoas da mesma família estavam no imóvel no momento do fogo. Bombeiros controlaram as chamas e fazem buscas sob os escombros.
articles.summary: Segundo testemunhas, cinco pessoas da mesma família estavam no imóvel no momento do fogo; bombeiros controlaram as chamas e fazem buscas sob os escombros.
articles.body:
Um incêndio de grandes proporções foi registrado na noite de sábado (5), no bairro São José, em Capanema , no nordeste do Pará.

Ao menos quatro pessoas da mesma família morreram, segundo moradores. Ainda não há confirmação oficial sobre o número de mortos.

O g1 solicitou mais informações ao Corpo de Bombeiros, mas ainda não havia obtido resposta até a última atualização da reportagem.

De acordo com informações preliminares, o fogo atingiu uma loja de peças de automóveis e uma residência no mesmo prédio. A família estava no segundo andar do imóvel e teria ficado presa enquanto o fogo e a fumaça se espalhavam rapidamente pelo andar de baixo, onde funcionaria a loja.

Um incêndio de grandes proporções deixa mortos em Capanema-PA — Foto: Reprodução

O Corpo de Bombeiros Militar informou que o incêndio já foi controlado e que, neste momento, a ocorrência está na fase de rescaldo, operação realizada para eliminar focos remanescentes e evitar que as chamas voltem.

Ainda segundo a corporação, a perícia foi solicitada para apurar as causas do incêndio.

Testemunhas relataram que ao menos quatro pessoas da mesma família estavam no local no momento do incêndio e são procuradas pelas equipes de resgate.

Os corpos ainda estariam sob os escombros, e máquinas devem ser utilizadas para auxiliar na retirada, já que parte da estrutura desabou.

As informações preliminares apontam que entre as vítimas estariam crianças, com idades entre 8 e 12 anos, além dos pais. No entanto, a identidade das vítimas ainda não foi oficialmente divulgada.

Corpo de Bombeiros faz buscas por vítimas de incêndio em Capanema, no Pará. — Foto: Reprodução

articles.title: Pessoas com deficiência no mercado de trabalho: histórias em Jundiaí | G1
articles.standfirst: Profissionais com deficiência visual e auditiva relatam avanços no mercado de trabalho e na autonomia; dados do IBGE mostram que a taxa de ocupação do grupo ainda é de 26,6% no Brasil.
articles.summary: Pessoas com deficiência no mercado de trabalho em Jundiaí relatam como a qualificação e a acessibilidade garantem autonomia e superam as baixas taxas de ocupação nacionais.
articles.body:
A inclusão de pessoas com deficiência (PCD) no mercado de trabalho em Jundiaí (SP) tem caminhado para além do cumprimento das leis. Histórias de profissionais da cidade mostram como a reabilitação, o acesso à educação e a adaptação do ambiente de trabalho transformam a busca por autonomia em trajetórias de sucesso.

No Instituto Luiz Braille, em Jundiaí, o atendimento ao público ganha o reforço de Cássio Vicente, que tem deficiência visual desde que nasceu e que atua há três anos na recepção. Na mesma instituição, o psicólogo Gilson Modesto utiliza a própria história para reabilitar e orientar outros deficientes visuais. Ele perdeu a visão aos 19 anos devido a um descolamento de retina.

"As empresas que me contratam não veem a minha deficiência, veem a minha eficiência. Não é legal uma empresa colocar você no mercado só para preencher cota", ressalta Gilson.

Na área de tecnologia, João Victor, que perdeu a visão aos cinco anos, especializou-se em acessibilidade digital. Após passar pelo processo de reabilitação no instituto, hoje ele ensina outros alunos a utilizarem leitores de tela em celulares e computadores para navegar na internet, pedir refeições ou solicitar transporte por aplicativo.

Apesar de iniciativas locais bem-sucedidas, o cenário nacional ainda apresenta grandes disparidades. Segundo dados do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE), cerca de 18,6 milhões de pessoas têm algum tipo de deficiência no Brasil:

Escolaridade: apenas 25% das pessoas com deficiência concluem ao menos o ensino médio, contra 57% da população sem deficiência;

Mercado de trabalho: o nível de ocupação é de 26,6% entre o público com deficiência, enquanto atinge 60,7% entre os demais trabalhadores.

Lucas Felix tem deficiência auditiva de nascença e leciona design e paisagismo no Senac de Jundiaí (SP) — Foto: Reprodução / TV TEM

Superando os gargalos da formação, Lucas Felix, que tem deficiência auditiva de nascença e possui pós-mestrado em Arquitetura, leciona design e paisagismo no Senac de Jundiaí. Aprovado em processo seletivo pelas suas qualificações profissionais, ele atua em sala de aula com o suporte da intérprete de Libras Ana Paula.

"Entendi que o problema não era ser surdo ou ouvinte. Qualquer limitação da pessoa, em qualquer lugar ou trabalho, conseguindo fazer uma adaptação, você é capaz de fazer as coisas", pontua o professor.

articles.title: Cão cai na galeria de macrodrenagem de Balneário Camboriú | G1
articles.standfirst: Cão estava cansado, com dificuldade respiratória e tremores intensos. Animal foi secado com panos e entregue à tutora.
articles.summary: Animal foi secado com panos e entregue à tutora.
articles.body:
Um cachorro caiu em uma abertura da galeria de macrodrenagem da praia alargada de Balneário Camboriú , no Litoral Norte de Santa Catarina , e precisou ser resgatado pelos bombeiros. O cão estava cansado, com dificuldade respiratória e tremores intensos e foi entregue à tutora.

O caso ocorreu na manhã deste domingo (6). A prefeitura disse por nota que a área onde o cachorro caiu estava isolada e sinalizada com cercamento do tipo cerquite ( veja na foto mais abaixo ). "Diante do ocorrido, a Prefeitura determinou o reforço do fechamento das áreas de intervenção remanescentes na faixa de areia" ( leia a nota na íntegra no final da reportagem ).

O município lembrou ainda que a lei municipal número 2.445/2005 proíbe a presença de animais na praia e determina que eles só podem circular em outros espaços públicos com guia .

Dois guarda-vidas entraram na galeria para fazer resgate

O Corpo de Bombeiros Militar foi chamado às 8h05 na Praia Central. Moradores foram avisar no posto guarda-vidas sobre a queda do cão.

Os socorristas foram de quadriciclo até o local. A galeria onde o cachorro caiu é de difícil acesso e com presença de água. A abertura na areia tem cerca de 1 metro quadrado.

Para o resgate, um guarda-vida entrou dentro da galeria. Foi constatado que a profundidade era de cerca de 1,70 metro e a água fazia uma leve correnteza .

Inicialmente, o guarda-vida não conseguiu ver o animal, mas era possível ouvi-lo. Ele se afastava na mesma direção da correnteza.

Área onde estava abertura de galeria estava cercada, mas cachorro ultrapassou, caiu e precisou ser resgatado pelos bombeiros — Foto: PMBC/CBMSC/Divulgação

Outra equipe dos bombeiros chegou com duas lanternas e outro guarda-vidas desceu na galeria para ajudar. Com os novos instrumentos, eles puderam caminhar dentro da estrutura.

Eles acompanharam o sentido da correnteza e, após 10 minutos de buscas, acharam o cão, que estava a cerca de 60 metros da abertura da galeria onde ele havia caído .

Com uma escada, os guarda-vidas saíram da estrutura, trazendo o cachorro. O animal estava muito cansado e não conseguiu ficar em pé .

O cachorro foi secado com panos, para ser aquecido, e o quadro de saúde dele melhorou. Depois, foi entregue à tutora, que se comprometeu a levá-lo em um veterinário.

Os guarda-vidas fizeram o isolamento da área a avisaram a prefeitura sobre o ocorrido.

O município disse que, apesar de o local estar cercado, o cachorro conseguiu ultrapassar as barreiras e acabou caindo.

Após resgate de cão que caiu em galeria de macrodrenagem, abertura foi fechada em Balneário Camboriú — Foto: PMBC/Divulgação

Confira abaixo a nota da Prefeitura de Balneário Camboriú sobre o ocorrido.

A Prefeitura de Balneário Camboriú tomou conhecimento da ocorrência registrada na manhã deste domingo (6), em que um cão caiu em uma abertura da galeria de macrodrenagem na faixa de areia da Praia Central. Diante do ocorrido, a Secretaria de Planejamento e Desenvolvimento Urbano entrou imediatamente em contato com a empresa responsável pela execução da obra, que já tomou as providências necessárias para reforçar a segurança das áreas que ainda permanecem em intervenção.

Todas as caixas de inspeção já foram devidamente fechadas. Resta apenas uma abertura na altura da Rua 1131. Devido ao tamanho, a empresa responsável se comprometeu a instalar a tampa na terça-feira (8). Até a instalação, o local recebeu reforço na sinalização.

A empresa já havia sido formalmente comunicada para concluir os serviços remanescentes, incluindo a execução dos poços de visita, a retirada do canteiro, a limpeza e a finalização das frentes de trabalho.

Em reunião realizada em 23 de julho, havia sido estabelecido o prazo de 14 de agosto para a conclusão dos serviços. Como o prazo não foi cumprido, a Prefeitura reiterou a cobrança em 18 de agosto e estabeleceu novo prazo. Até o momento, porém, as pendências não foram integralmente solucionadas. Diante dos descumprimentos, o Município já adotou as medidas administrativas cabíveis para a penalização da empresa.

A Prefeitura considera inadmissível a permanência de serviços inacabados além dos prazos determinados e reforça que a segurança da população e dos usuários da Praia Central é prioridade. O Município seguirá cobrando a regularização dos locais e a responsabilização contratual da empresa executora.

A Prefeitura reforça que a população deve respeitar as barreiras de segurança, que têm a função de impedir o acesso às áreas de intervenção e proteger a população. Essas estruturas não devem ser rompidas, removidas ou danificadas. A violação ou depredação das barreiras, além de colocar pessoas e animais em risco, pode gerar responsabilização.

No local da ocorrência desta manhã, a área estava isolada e sinalizada com cercamento do tipo cerquite, sem acesso liberado ao público. Ainda assim, diante do ocorrido, a Prefeitura determinou o reforço do fechamento das áreas de intervenção remanescentes na faixa de areia, com o objetivo de ampliar a segurança no local.

articles.title: Desfile de 7 de Setembro altera trânsito na Av. Beira-Mar em Fortaleza | G1
articles.standfirst: Operação da AMC com 200 agentes começa no domingo (6) com proibição de estacionamento. Na segunda-feira (7), as vias serão bloqueadas a partir das 5h.
articles.summary: Operação da AMC com 200 agentes começa no domingo (6) com proibição de estacionamento. Na segunda-feira (7), as vias serão bloqueadas a partir das 5h.
articles.body:
Desfile de 7 de Setembro altera trânsito na Avenida Beira-Mar, em Fortaleza. — Foto: Fabiane de Paula/SVM

O trânsito na Avenida Beira-Mar, em Fortaleza , vai ser alterado, nesta segunda-feira (7), devido ao desfile cívico-militar tradicional do Dia da Independência . A Autarquia Municipal de Trânsito e Cidadania (AMC) montou uma operação especial de mobilidade para garantir a segurança e organizar o tráfego na via.

A operação começa já neste domingo (6), a partir das 22h, com a proibição de estacionamento na Avenida Beira-Mar, no trecho compreendido entre as avenidas Rui Barbosa e Vicente de Castro.

A ação contará com bloqueios e desvios de tráfego, além do trabalho de 200 agentes e orientadores de trânsito. Eles estarão distribuídos em pontos estratégicos para auxiliar motoristas, pedestres e demais usuários da via.

Na segunda-feira (7), às 5h, começam as interdições para facilitar a chegada das tropas militares e dos estudantes que participarão do evento. As avenidas Historiador Raimundo Girão e Beira-Mar estarão totalmente bloqueadas, assim como as vias transversais que dão acesso à orla.

A Avenida Abolição irá operar normalmente no sentido Centro-Mucuripe, mas terá o fluxo bloqueado no sentido contrário (Mucuripe-Centro).

A recomendação para os condutores que irão prestigiar o desfile é estacionar nas vias transversais às avenidas Abolição e Monsenhor Tabosa, respeitando as placas de sinalização.

Devido aos bloqueios, os motoristas devem utilizar rotas alternativas . No sentido Centro-Mucuripe, a orientação é seguir pela Avenida Monsenhor Tabosa.

Já no sentido Mucuripe-Centro, o desvio de tráfego deve ser feito pela Avenida Almirante Henrique Saboia (Via Expressa).

Outras rotas alternativas incluem as avenidas Padre Antônio Tomás, Santos Dumont e Dom Luís. A operação especial está prevista para seguir até as 13h.

articles.title: Trânsito em Aracaju terá alterações no desfile de 7 de Setembro | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo a SMTT, a Avenida Barão de Maruim e as ruas próximas ficarão interditadas das 5h30 às 18h.
articles.summary: A SMTT detalhou as interdições na Avenida Barão de Maruim e rotas alternativas para o trânsito em Aracaju no 7 de Setembro, com bloqueios das 5h30 às 18h.
articles.body:
Desfile de 7 de Setembro em Aracaju — Foto: Anderson Barbosa/TV Sergipe/Arquivo

O trânsito na região central de Aracaju vai sofrer mudanças nesta segunda-feira, durante o desfile de 7 de Setembro, em homenagem à Independência do Brasil.

Segundo a Superintendência Municipal de Transportes e Trânsito (SMTT), a Avenida Barão de Maruim e as ruas próximas ficarão interditadas das 5h30 às 18h. Também haverá bloqueio na Avenida Ivo do Prado, no trecho entre a Travessa José de Faro e a Avenida Augusto Maynard.

Os condutores que precisarem se deslocar entre o Centro e a região das praias poderão utilizar as avenidas Hermes Fontes e Pedro Calazans como alternativas.

Para quem estiver na Avenida Ivo do Prado, no sentido Centro/praias, a rota alternativa começa na Praça Fausto Cardoso. A partir dali, os motoristas deverão seguir pela Travessa José de Faro, Rua Itaporanga e acessar a Avenida Pedro Calazans.

No sentido praias/Centro, o deslocamento deverá ser feito pelas avenidas Augusto Maynard, Gonçalo Prado Rollemberg, Edézio Vieira de Melo e Hermes Fontes, contornando a área onde ocorrerá o desfile.

articles.title: Three attempted murder arrests after two separate stabbings
articles.summary: Three people are being questioned on suspicion of attempted murder after stabbings in Newry and Lurgan on Sunday.
articles.body:
Three people have been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after two separate stabbings in Newry and Lurgan.

In the Newry incident, police say they were called to a house in the Woodhill area after 06:00 BST on Sunday, where a man with stab wounds was found inside.

And a man in his 40s is in a serious condition in hospital after he was stabbed in the back at a property in the Grattan Street area of Lurgan on Sunday afternoon.

Armed response officers were sent to the scene. The suspect, a 34-year-old man, was arrested a short distance away.

A man and woman in their 30s were also arrested on suspicion of attempted murder in relation to the Newry incident.

The Police Service of Northern Ireland has appealed to anyone with information on either incident to come forward.

articles.title: Delhi building collapse: 5 dead, 5 rescued; 'will spare no one', CM Rekha vows action - top developments
articles.summary: India News: NEW DELHI: Five people were killed and five were rescued after a five-storey boys' paying guest (PG) accommodation collapsed in southwest Delhi's Saty.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Five people were killed and five were rescued after a five-storey boys' paying guest (PG) accommodation collapsed in southwest Delhi's Satya Niketan area on Sunday, officials said. Rescue operations were under way to search for any remaining people trapped under the rubble.The collapse involved a building known as 'Hostel Daze', which was being used as a boys' PG. An adjacent building also collapsed, according to eyewitnesses.JPN Apex Trauma Centre (AIIMS), on late Sunday, informed that it received 10 patients from the Satya Niketan building collapse. Four were brought dead, while one critically injured patient later succumbed. Three are admitted and undergoing treatment, one underwent limb surgery, and one with minor injuries was discharged after observation.3 killed among 9 rescued as rescue operation continuesThe AIIMS Trauma Centre said eight injured people were brought to hospitals following the incident. Seven were taken to the AIIMS Trauma Centre, while one was admitted to Safdarjung Hospital. Two of those brought to AIIMS were declared brought dead.The death toll later rose to three, with authorities confirming that six people had been rescued from the rubble.Two National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) teams were deployed at the site, while two additional teams were kept on standby, NDRF Inspector General NS Bundela said. Rescue teams were working in coordination with the State Disaster Response Force, Delhi Fire Service and other agencies.Eight fire tenders on spotThe Delhi Fire Service received information about the collapse at around 1.30 pm, following which eight fire tenders and multiple rescue teams were rushed to the spot. Police also cordoned off the area as rescuers searched through the debris.Eyewitnesses said several students were believed to be inside the building when it collapsed. A local resident claimed the PG had around 15 rooms, with two to three students staying in each room, and that around 35 to 40 students were residing on its upper floors.Residents said many students were inside their rooms because it was Sunday. Several locals joined the rescue operation, removing debris with their hands and whatever tools were available.Basement construction work under scannerResidents alleged that construction or repair work was under way in the basement and that water had accumulated there. A local resident who has lived in the area for around two decades claimed the building's foundation was weak.Another resident said he had been inside the building shortly before the collapse and managed to get out minutes before the structure came down.The adjacent building was also reportedly leaning after the collapse, raising concerns about the safety of nearby structures.Students from several states among residentsResidents said most students staying at the PG were from Kerala, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh and attended colleges including Motilal Nehru College, Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College and Sri Venkateswara College.One resident said students were paying around Rs 12,000 per bed at the accommodation. Residents also raised concerns about the condition of buildings in the congested locality, where several residential properties have reportedly been converted into student PG accommodations.CM Rekha Gupta visits collapse siteDelhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta visited the site and reviewed the ongoing search and rescue operation. Emergency teams continued clearing the rubble and searching for anyone who may still be trapped."No one will be spared," she says.The Rekha Gupta-led Delhi government has ordered a magisterial inquiry into the incident and directed that an FIR be registered against the building owner, the chief minister’s office (CMO) said.The decision was taken following an on-site review and a preliminary assessment of the incident, the CMO said.“Following an on-site review and based on the preliminary assessment, the chief minister has ordered a Magisterial Inquiry of the incident and an FIR against the building owner,” the CMO said.It added that those found responsible for the incident would be held fully accountable and face the strictest provisions of the law.PM Modi expresses condolencesPrime Minister Narendra Modi expressed condolences over the deaths in the Satya Niketan building collapse and prayed for the speedy recovery of those injured. He said authorities were working at the site and assisting people affected by the incident.Get the latest India News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Three charged with attempted murder after Braintree shooting
articles.summary: The two adults and teenager will appear in court on Monday.
articles.body:
Two adults and a teenager have been charged with attempted murder after a shotgun was fired in a town centre.

Police were called to Market Place in Braintree , Essex, at about 22:10 BST on Monday following what officers described as a "targeted attack".

Two teenagers sustained serious injuries to their face and upper body, while a third person was also injured.

Destiny Ema, 23, of Meadgate Avenue, Chelmsford, Kayden Brown, 18, of Noaks Avenue, Chelmsford, and a 17-year-old from Braintree who cannot be named for legal reasons are due to appear at Chelmsford Magistrates' Court on Monday.

A 16-year-old boy previously arrested in connection with the incident has been released on police bail until 30 November.

Ema was also charged with numerous other offences connected to separate investigations including:

Attempted grievous bodily harm with intent

Possession of a firearm with intent to cause fear of violence

Possession of a firearm while committing an indictable offence

Possession of a firearm while prohibited for life

Possession of a shotgun with intent to cause fear of violence

articles.body: An East Texas sheriff’s deputy got the scare of his life when a deer he thought was dead suddenly sprang to its feet, sending the startled lawman screaming back toward his cruiser in a moment caught on camera that quickly went viral online. The wild encounter was captured on the deputy’s dashcam and shared on Facebook by Trinity County Sheriff Woody Wallace, who joked that sometimes things can "scare the heck out of a person." Wallace had some fun with the incident, encouraging social media users to "[w]atch when he encounters what he thinks is a dead deer until it comes back to life!" BIG SKY, MONTANA WILDLIFE ENCOUNTER CAUGHT ON VIDEO AS MOOSE CHARGES TOWARD WOMAN AND HER DOGS As the deputy gets closer to examine the animal, the deer suddenly springs to life. The deer is last seen sitting up on the side of the road before the video ends. articles.title: Michigan fans called out on social media for rushing field after Wolverines steal win over Western Michigan
articles.summary: Michigan fans stormed the field after Bryce Underwood's Hail Mary saved a 13-12 win over Western Michigan, sparking college football debate.
articles.body: Emotions are what make college football great, but there is a fine line between showing raw emotions and letting emotions get the best of you. The latter happened in Ann Arbor, Michigan, on Saturday night. The Michigan Wolverines were beaten – and some would say literally – by Western Michigan on Saturday before one of the more unbelievable scenes in the sport's history unfolded. After Michigan quarterback Bryce Underwood sailed his Hail Mary attempt out of the back of the endzone and the clock hit triple zeros, the officials reviewed the play and elected to put one second back on the clock. The video review seen on the NBC broadcast left no doubt that time had expired on the clocks available to the network, but a second was added, and the rest is history. CLOCK CONTROVERSY ALLOWS MICHIGAN WOLVERINES TO AVOID MASSIVE UPSET AGAINST WESTERN MICHIGAN Underwood's second Hail Mary attempt was perfect as he lobbed a pass to the goal line for 6-foot-4 receiver JJ Buchanan to go up and get it, and get it he did. With Michigan stealing a 13-12 win over the Broncos in dramatic fashion, the fans who stuck around in The Big House stormed the field to celebrate. While the Wolverines have gone through a significant amount of change in leadership and coaching in recent months, it's still the same Michigan that is just three years removed from winning a national title, and its fans rushing the field after beating a MAC team was quite the scene. articles.title: Isro says its 'next chapter' is leading national space ecosystem
articles.summary: India News: BENGALURU: Two days after nine employee bodies at Isro centres sought written clarity on the future role of the organisation amid space-sector reforms.
articles.body: BENGALURU: Two days after nine employee bodies at Isro centres sought written clarity on the future role of the organisation amid space-sector reforms, Isro on Sunday hinted at its “next chapter” while categorically stating that it “would neither be privatised nor will its importance be diminished”.“Isro will continue to remain India’s principal institution for advanced space R&D, national and strategic missions, space science and exploration, and critical and frontier space capabilities. Participation of the private sector is not about reducing Isro’s role. It is about enabling Isro to focus even more strongly on the next generation of India’s space programme, while industry scales mature technologies and capabilities,” Isro said.Also read:Isro will remain ‘bedrock of Indian space sector’, says GoenkaWhat is changing is not the importance of Isro, but the scale and structure of India’s space ecosystem, it said, adding that the space-sector reforms institutionalised through the Indian Space Policy 2023, along with progressive liberalisation of FDI policy, aim to create a larger, stronger and globally competitive Indian space ecosystem.“Industry, start-ups and academia are being enabled to participate across the space value chain, complementing and multiplying Isro’s capabilities. The reforms should therefore be seen as ecosystem expansion and capability multiplication, not privatisation,” Isro said.As India’s industrial and technological capabilities have grown, mature and scalable activities can increasingly be undertaken by Indian industry, it said, adding Isro has already transferred multiple technologies to industry.“Transferring a mature technology doesn’t mean Isro is withdrawing from that domain. It enables large-scale production, commercialisation, innovation and access to global markets while allowing Isro’s scientific and technical manpower to concentrate on advanced research, next-generation technologies and complex national missions,” It said.The transition is therefore towards an “Isro-led national space ecosystem.” “...Isro’s role will progressively strengthen in areas where its scientific expertise matters most: frontier R&D, advanced technologies, human spaceflight, next-generation launch systems, deep-space and planetary missions and strategic national capabilities,” it said.The agency added that it’ll continue developing cutting-edge technologies, including advanced payloads for communication, navigation and Earth observation, sensors, propulsion systems and other critical technologies.“Meanwhile, mature and routinely manufactured systems can increasingly be scaled through industry. Production of mature launch vehicles, routine satellites and other established systems can increasingly be undertaken by industry or PSUs through appropriate competitive processes,” Isro said.This, it says, allows Isro to devote more resources and scientific manpower to the next generation of technologies and missions, while the wider ecosystem provides the investment, manufacturing capacity and scale required by an expanding national space programme.Pointing out that the transition was important in the context of Space Vision 2047, it said technologies needed for establishing the Bharatiya Antariksh Station by 2035, crewed mission to Moon by 2040, developing next-generation and reusable launch systems, pursuing sustained lunar and planetary exploration, and establishing India as a major global space power, require Isro to remain focused on advanced research and capabilities that cannot simply be substituted by commercial activity.The objective is “therefore to enable industry to scale mature capabilities while Isro pushes India towards the next technological frontier”.“The Department of Space provides overall policy direction, Isro remains the core organisation for advanced R&D, technology development and national missions. IN-SPACe facilitates and authorises the participation of non-government entities, while NSIL undertakes commercialisation and industry-led utilisation of mature capabilities,” Isro said.It added that industry and start-ups contribute investment, innovation, manufacturing capacity and market access. “At the same time, ownership and control of critical national space infrastructure and strategic capabilities will continue to remain with the Govt. Private participation in operations and services will be enabled where appropriate and will remain subject to national-security, safety and other regulatory requirements. Strategic and nationally critical capabilities will continue to be governed by security, safety, quality and national-interest considerations,” it said.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: India eyes nuclear power in Andamans as China challenge grows near Malacca Strait
articles.summary: News News: Scientists from the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) have begun assessing potential sites for Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) across the Andaman and.
articles.body: Scientists from the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) have begun assessing potential sites for Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) across the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. This move could strengthen the archipelago’s energy resilience as India expands strategic and civilian infrastructure near the Strait of Malacca.A team from the Department of Atomic Energy is visiting the islands from September 4 to 8 to assess potential sites across all three districts. The exercise follows a recommendation to explore SMRs to meet the archipelago’s rapidly growing power requirements.Electricity demand is expected to rise sharply as major infrastructure projects take shape, including the International Container Transhipment Terminal, a greenfield airport and deep-water multipurpose ports.The BARC team has also briefed Andaman and Nicobar Islands Lieutenant Governor Admiral D K Joshi on potential sites and other features of the proposed SMR plan.Great Nicobar ProjectThe proposed SMR sites assume added significance against the backdrop of the Great Nicobar Project, one of India’s most strategically important infrastructure initiatives in the region.The project envisages an International Container Transhipment Terminal at Galathea Bay, a greenfield international airport, a township and associated power infrastructure. The government has described the project as having strategic, defence and national-security significance.The project is also aimed at strengthening India’s presence in the Andaman Sea and Southeast Asia while establishing a major maritime hub close to key international shipping routes.Its location gives the project significance beyond trade and connectivity. It comes as India seeks to expand its economic and strategic footprint in the eastern Indian Ocean and strengthen its ability to monitor maritime activity in the region.Countering China, watching the Malacca StraitThe proposed SMR sites acquire a broader strategic dimension because Great Nicobar is emerging as a key component of India’s efforts to strengthen its position in the eastern Indian Ocean amid China’s growing presence in the region.The government has explicitly described the Great Nicobar Project as having strategic, defence and national-security importance. It has said that a strong and permanent defence presence on the island would help India monitor and secure maritime routes while countering the growing presence of foreign powers in the Indian Ocean.The Strait of Malacca is central to this strategy. A major maritime chokepoint, it carries substantial volumes of global trade and energy supplies between the Indian Ocean and the Pacific. Great Nicobar’s location gives India a strategically important position near the western approaches to the strait.The Ministry of Defence has previously highlighted the importance of INS Baaz at Campbell Bay, noting that the naval air station overlooks the Strait of Malacca and the Six Degree Channel.The wider Andaman and Nicobar Command, India’s only integrated tri-services command, was established in recognition of the archipelago’s strategic location astride important sea lines of communication.The Ministry of Defence has said the islands’ geography enables India to safeguard its maritime interests and deter potential threats, giving the command an important role in the country’s broader Act East strategy.

articles.title: Niger military accuses France of orchestrating failed mutiny: What to know
articles.summary: French officials deny involvement, but tensions between the two countries remain high.
articles.body:
Niger’s military government has accused France of orchestrating a failed mutiny that rocked the capital, Niamey, last week.

France denied any involvement in the events in its former colony, but the accusation indicates that tensions between them remain high.

Shortly after midnight on August 29, renegade soldiers targeted Base 101, a major military facility inside Niamey’s international airport complex.

Authorities said the mutineers detained some of their comrades and opened fire at “certain sensitive sites” in the capital.

Fighting spread to the presidential palace and temporarily knocked the state broadcaster off air, with explosions and gunfire echoing around Niamey for hours until Niger’s army, helped by Russian paramilitary fighters known as the Africa Corps , contained the mutiny.

State media said hundreds of soldiers took part, with dozens killed or arrested.

The mutiny happened three years after Abdourahamane Tchiani seized power in a coup that overthrew President Mohamed Bazoum, saying the elected government had failed to contain armed groups. However, violent unrest has persisted, while governance grievances and economic challenges remain.

What has Niger’s military government said?

As with previous rounds of unrest, Niger’s military authorities blamed France and other West African countries.

“This operation, with its international ramifications, was instigated and sustained by a vast network of collusion headed by the French regime of Mr [Emmanuel] Macron,” said Soumana Boubacar, Niger’s government spokesperson, in a statement read out on TV on Friday.

“Traitorous and renegade elements, to whom promises of great things were made, were tasked with carrying out unfulfilled ambitions of Macron and his cronies in our country,” he said, adding that such “undermining manoeuvres will always fail”.

The Niger Council of Ministers, which functions as the cabinet since the 2023 coup, said a “substantial body of evidence has been compiled regarding this attack and Niger reserves the right to ⁠⁠bring the matter before international courts”. Details were not provided.

Niger also accused a number of regional countries of being involved, including the regional economic bloc ECOWAS. Benin’s government, one of the countries accused, rejected the accusations.

In contrast, Niger thanked Russia, Algeria and allies in the Sahel region – Burkina Faso and Mali – for their support.

France dismissed the allegations as “pure fantasy”.

“There never was any intention, nor means that France would have mobilised,” French Foreign Minister, Jean-Noel Barrot, told the French radio station, RFI.

“All of this is, as usual, a way of wrongly blaming France for something it is simply not responsible for.”

Tensions between the two countries have increased following the 2023 coup.

Niger has since ordered the withdrawal of about 1,500 French troops, expelled the French ambassador, revoked a number of bilateral military agreements and suspended French state-funded stations, such as France 24 and RFI, from broadcasting there.

Is Niger’s security situation worsening?

Henri Nsaibia, West Africa senior analyst at Armed Conflict Location & Event Data (ACLED), said the Nigerien armed forces’ fight against armed groups linked to ISIL and al-Qaeda could be weakened following the mutiny.

“The regime will likely divert resources from fighting jihadist groups to monitor internal threats,” he said.

Niger’s security situation is facing several challenges.

Since the 2023 coup, nearly 6,000 people have been killed in more than 1,400 violent incidents, according to ACLED. The casualties represent a sharp increase compared to the three years before Tchiani was in power, when nearly 3,200 people were killed in more than 1,300 violent incidents.

“Niger still experiences less intense violence than neighbouring Mali and Burkina Faso, but faces a wider range of armed threats,” said Nsaibia.

What’s the history of French colonialism in Niger?

France’s influence has dropped dramatically throughout its former colonies in West Africa in recent years in the wake of failed military interventions and allegations of interference.

The rise in anti-French sentiment has helped coup leaders in a number of countries claim legitimacy, including in Niger, where France has a long history of brutality.

France’s 1899 military campaign in Niger is still remembered for its intense violence, mass executions and destruction of towns and villages.

Niger became part of France’s colonial empire the following year and gained independence in 1960, but Paris still meddled in its internal politics and economic policies.

In recent years, discussions about potential reparations as compensation for the looting and extraction of the country’s resources during and after French rule have intensified.

articles.title: From drones to assassins: Russia's hybrid war in Europe could turn deadly, experts warn
articles.summary: Europe News: A growing series of suspected Russian sabotage operations across Europe is raising fears that Moscow’s campaign of covert pressure could escalate into.
articles.body: A growing series of suspected Russian sabotage operations across Europe is raising fears that Moscow’s campaign of covert pressure could escalate into attempts to kill senior defence officials and other prominent targets, security experts have warned.Germany has emerged as a particular focus of concern after Berlin formally accused Russia of orchestrating an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport on August 4. German authorities said an explosive-laden drone was found near a Ukrainian cargo aircraft and that the incident matched patterns seen in previous Russian hybrid operations. Moscow has denied the allegations.The warning comes amid a wider series of suspected acts of sabotage targeting critical infrastructure, defence facilities and government systems across Europe. European officials have increasingly described such operations as part of a Russian “hybrid war” designed to disrupt support for Ukraine while remaining below the threshold of conventional conflict.Germany fears Russian operations could turn deadlyGerman lawmaker and security expert Roderich Kiesewetter warned that the next phase could include attempts to kill senior figures in the defence industry. He predicted an increase in what he described as “state terrorism” on German soil, saying traces of such operations could lead back to Moscow.Former British defence minister Tobias Ellwood similarly warned that another poisoning operation resembling the 2018 Salisbury attack could occur, arguing that Russia has become adept at exploiting the “grey area” between conventional warfare and covert operations.The Salisbury attack, in which former Russian intelligence officer Sergei Skripal and his daughter were poisoned with the nerve agent Novichok, remains one of the most serious examples of suspected Russian covert action on British soil. A woman, Dawn Sturgess, later died after coming into contact with the discarded poison.But the threat is broader than assassination plots. Atlantic Council experts warn that Russia has been repeatedly testing how far it can push European countries and Nato without triggering a decisive response — using drone incursions, cyberattacks, sabotage, arson, GPS jamming and disinformation.Disposable agents, sabotage and deniabilityAccording to a report by Express, Western intelligence assessments indicate that Russia has increasingly relied on disposable operatives recruited online, including through Telegram, and paid in cryptocurrency. Such agents have allegedly been used in arson attacks, railway sabotage and attempted attacks while helping Moscow maintain plausible deniability.The concern extends beyond Germany. Atlantic Council experts identify the Baltic states, Poland, the Nordic countries, Moldova and Romania as potential pressure points, where Moscow could exploit vulnerabilities through airspace incursions, attacks on infrastructure, cyber operations, maritime threats and disinformation.The underlying concern is that these operations may serve as more than isolated acts of disruption. They can also function as tests of Nato's political will and ability to respond quickly and collectively. A successful limited operation could reveal gaps in allied defences or encourage Moscow to push further.The Atlantic Council also warns that Russia could increasingly target the political cohesion of the West itself. Rather than trying to defeat Nato militarily, Moscow could exploit polarisation, distrust in institutions and tensions between Washington and European capitals, amplifying narratives that Nato is obsolete, Ukraine is doomed and the US can no longer rely on its allies.Catch the latest World News and Live updates.
